verdict.rationale: A probe confirms NVIDIA's developer portal (linked to RTX 5080's CUDA/developer ecosystem) serves a working llms.txt file with HTTP 200 and descriptive content, showing genuine agent-oriented documentation support. However, related agent-friendly formats (docs.md, openapi.json) all returned 404s, indicating the llms.txt support is thin/partial rather than a comprehensive agent-doc ecosystem. Missing for 10: markdown-mirrored docs, an OpenAPI/schema endpoint, and RTX-5080-specific (vs. generic developer portal) llms.txt content.
